svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 1,150 x 750 mm of 1.5 mm galvanized sheet. Fold lines along

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the 1,150 mm length at 25, 275, 475 and 725 mm from one edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold the two outer 25 mm strips out (feet) and the 250 mm legs

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: down, to an inverted channel 200 wide, 250 high, with feet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Have it folded by a sheet metal shop, or fold it between two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1.2 m steel angles clamped to a bench.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Peg holes: four 9 mm, centred in the feet, 40 and 455 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the upslope end. Only the upslope half is pegged, so the crack

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: can open under the downslope half.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Reader screw holes: two 4.5 mm in the web, 100 and 150 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the upslope end, 52 mm to one side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands over the gauge on its feet, 48 mm above the pin tops.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the web is flat and the legs square within 3 mm.
